# prime-message

prime-rs: Message component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/message) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-message) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/message.md)

Message: port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-message`.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-message[role=alert]` (instead of the `<p-message>` host), inside it
`div.p-message-content-wrapper` > `div.p-message-content` with an icon, text and a close button.

As in PrimeNG, when `text` is set a `span.p-message-text` with the text is rendered, followed by a second `span.p-message-text`
with the child content. A closed message is hidden (`p-message-leave-active` and `display: none`) without animation.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_message::{Message, MessageSeverity};

let html = view! { <Message severity=MessageSeverity::Success text="Saved" closable=true /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-message-success") && html.contains("p-message-close-button") && html.contains("Saved"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-message = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["message"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
